title: What happens if you stay awake for 3 days? Day 3

beats.text: Day three without sleep. Hour 72. This is where the brain starts to break.
The urge to sleep becomes almost impossible to fight. Microsleeps get longer, and they come more often.
Then the hallucinations start. People report seeing, hearing, and even feeling things that aren't there.
Thinking gets messy, and some start believing things that aren't true. Researchers compare it to psychosis.
In 1964, a 17 year old named Randy Gardner stayed awake for 11 days, for a school science fair.
It was so risky that Guinness later stopped tracking the record.
The good news? For most people, sleep fixes it. Randy slept about 14 hours, and woke up feeling mostly fine.
So please, don't try this. Which day surprised you most? One, two, or three? Tell me below.
